notes.title: Scenario 1 Released! Thank you Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/392370

Thank you so much everyone, and a special thanks again to the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/305439676/change-localization-by-supporting-culture-select-w/description]Kickstarter[/url] team that brought this game to life from the doujin floor of Japan to the Western market.

If it does well maybe we can fund additional scenarios of the game! There's quite a few! 

We hope you all enjoy it and comment on the discussion boards!
